// FittedPlatformerController.cs
// Generated by Reference Controller Fitter {{VERSION}} on {{DATE}}.
// Candidate model: {{MODEL}}   Fit trajectory error: {{FIT_ERROR}}   Confidence: {{CONFIDENCE}}
//
// A behaviourally similar 2D platformer controller fitted to reference footage. It is NOT
// the original game's code. All values are plain, editable Inspector fields.
//
// Setup: add this component to a GameObject with a BoxCollider2D (a Rigidbody2D is added
// automatically and switched to Kinematic). Put level geometry on the layers in
// "Solid Layers". Controls: A/D or arrow keys to move, Space to jump.
// Units: world units, 1 unit = {{UNIT_NOTE}}. Gravity of the physics engine is not used.
// Collision: axis-aligned solids. Surfaces steeper than 60 degrees are walls; slopes and one-way
// platforms are not supported. Move the character with Teleport() rather than transform.position.
//
// The motion integrator (Advance) is a line-by-line port of the fitter's model: it splits
// every fixed step exactly where the acceleration changes, so the motion does not depend
// on Time.fixedDeltaTime.

using System;
using UnityEngine;
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
#endif

[RequireComponent(typeof(Rigidbody2D))]
[RequireComponent(typeof(BoxCollider2D))]
public class FittedPlatformerController : MonoBehaviour
{
    [Header("Horizontal (units/s, units/s^2)")]
    public float maxSpeed = {{max_speed}}f;
    public float groundAccel = {{ground_accel}}f;
    public float groundDecel = {{ground_decel}}f;
    public float turnAccel = {{turn_accel}}f;

    [Header("Vertical")]
    public float jumpVelocity = {{jump_velocity}}f;
    public float riseGravity = {{rise_gravity}}f;
    public float fallGravity = {{fall_gravity}}f;
    [Tooltip("vy multiplier applied once when jump is released while rising (1 = off)")]
    [Range(0f, 1f)] public float jumpCut = {{jump_cut}}f;
    [Tooltip("Rise gravity multiplier while jump is not held (1 = off)")]
    public float releaseGravityMult = {{release_gravity_mult}}f;
    [Tooltip("Gravity multiplier near the apex while jump is held (1 = off)")]
    public float apexGravityMult = {{apex_gravity_mult}}f;
    [Tooltip("|vy| band in which the apex multiplier applies")]
    public float apexThreshold = {{apex_threshold}}f;
    [Tooltip("Terminal fall speed; 0 or less = unlimited")]
    public float maxFallSpeed = {{max_fall_speed}}f;

    [Header("Air")]
    [Tooltip("Multiplier on all horizontal rates while airborne")]
    public float airControl = {{air_control}}f;

    [Header("Optional: load parameters from the exported JSON at Awake")]
    [Tooltip("If assigned, the JSON values OVERRIDE the Inspector fields above when the game starts.")]
    public TextAsset fittedParamsJson;

    [Header("Collision")]
    [Tooltip("Layers that are solid for the character. Exclude enemies, pickups and the player's own layer.")]
    public LayerMask solidLayers = ~0;
    public float skinWidth = 0.01f;

    [Header("Forgiveness (NOT part of the fit; 0 = exactly the fitted behaviour)")]
    [Tooltip("Seconds after walking off a ledge during which a jump is still allowed (typ. 0.06-0.1).")]
    public float coyoteTime = 0f;
    [Tooltip("Seconds a jump press is remembered before landing (typ. 0.08-0.12).")]
    public float jumpBufferTime = 0f;

    // ---- state (world units, y up)
    public Vector2 Velocity => new Vector2(vx, vy);
    public bool IsGrounded => grounded;
    float vx, vy;
    bool grounded, jumpActive;
    int inputX;
    bool jumpHeld, jumpPressedBuffered, jumpReleasedBuffered;
    float coyoteTimer, bufferTimer;

    Rigidbody2D body;
    BoxCollider2D box;
    ContactFilter2D filter;
    readonly RaycastHit2D[] hits = new RaycastHit2D[8];

#pragma warning disable 0649 // fields are filled by JsonUtility
    [Serializable]
    class FittedParams
    {
        public float max_speed, ground_accel, ground_decel, turn_accel, jump_velocity, rise_gravity, fall_gravity;
        public float jump_cut = 1f, release_gravity_mult = 1f, apex_gravity_mult = 1f, apex_threshold, max_fall_speed, air_control = 1f;
    }

    [Serializable]
    class FittedFile { public FittedParams parameters; }
#pragma warning restore 0649

    [Header("Scripted input (tests, replays, AI)")]
    [Tooltip("When enabled the keyboard is ignored; call SetInput() instead.")]
    public bool useExternalInput = false;

    void Awake() { Initialize(); }

    /// <summary>Set up components (called from Awake; safe to call again).</summary>
    public void Initialize()
    {
        body = GetComponent<Rigidbody2D>();
        box = GetComponent<BoxCollider2D>();
        body.bodyType = RigidbodyType2D.Kinematic;
        body.interpolation = RigidbodyInterpolation2D.Interpolate;
        filter = new ContactFilter2D();
        filter.useTriggers = false;
        filter.SetLayerMask(solidLayers);
        if (fittedParamsJson != null) LoadJson(fittedParamsJson.text);
    }

    /// <summary>Apply parameters from the JSON written by Reference Controller Fitter.</summary>
    public void LoadJson(string json)
    {
        FittedFile file = JsonUtility.FromJson<FittedFile>(json);
        if (file == null || file.parameters == null) { Debug.LogWarning("FittedPlatformerController: no 'parameters' in JSON"); return; }
        FittedParams p = file.parameters;
        maxSpeed = p.max_speed; groundAccel = p.ground_accel; groundDecel = p.ground_decel; turnAccel = p.turn_accel;
        jumpVelocity = p.jump_velocity; riseGravity = p.rise_gravity; fallGravity = p.fall_gravity;
        jumpCut = p.jump_cut; releaseGravityMult = p.release_gravity_mult; apexGravityMult = p.apex_gravity_mult;
        apexThreshold = p.apex_threshold; maxFallSpeed = p.max_fall_speed; airControl = p.air_control;
    }

    void Update()
    {
        if (useExternalInput) return;
        bool left, right, jump;
        ReadInput(out left, out right, out jump);
        SetInput((right ? 1 : 0) - (left ? 1 : 0), jump);
    }

    /// <summary>Feed input directly: horizontal axis (-1, 0, 1) and whether jump is held.</summary>
    public void SetInput(int horizontal, bool jump)
    {
        inputX = Math.Sign(horizontal);
        if (jump && !jumpHeld) jumpPressedBuffered = true;
        if (!jump && jumpHeld) jumpReleasedBuffered = true;
        jumpHeld = jump;
    }

    void ReadInput(out bool left, out bool right, out bool jump)
    {
#if ENABLE_INPUT_SYSTEM
        Keyboard kb = Keyboard.current;
        left = kb != null && (kb.aKey.isPressed || kb.leftArrowKey.isPressed);
        right = kb != null && (kb.dKey.isPressed || kb.rightArrowKey.isPressed);
        jump = kb != null && kb.spaceKey.isPressed;
#else
        left = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.A) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.LeftArrow);
        right = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.D) || Input.GetKey(KeyCode.RightArrow);
        jump = Input.GetKey(KeyCode.Space);
#endif
    }

    void FixedUpdate() { Step(Time.fixedDeltaTime); }

    /// <summary>One fixed simulation step of dt seconds (FixedUpdate calls this).</summary>
    public void Step(float dt)
    {
        filter.SetLayerMask(solidLayers);

        // ---- ground check: is there still ground right below the feet?
        if (grounded && Gap(Vector2.zero, Vector2.down, skinWidth * 2f + 0.001f) < 0f)
        {
            grounded = false;   // walked off a ledge
            jumpActive = false;
            vy = 0f;
        }
        coyoteTimer = grounded ? coyoteTime : coyoteTimer - dt;

        // ---- jump input (pressed between fixed steps; optional buffer / coyote time)
        if (jumpPressedBuffered) bufferTimer = Mathf.Max(jumpBufferTime, dt);
        bool canJump = grounded || (coyoteTimer > 0f && !jumpActive && vy <= 0f);
        if (bufferTimer > 0f && canJump && (jumpHeld || jumpPressedBuffered))
        {
            vy = jumpVelocity;
            grounded = false;
            jumpActive = true;
            bufferTimer = 0f;
            coyoteTimer = 0f;
        }
        bufferTimer -= dt;
        if (jumpReleasedBuffered)
        {
            if (jumpActive && vy > 0f) vy *= jumpCut;
            jumpActive = false;
        }
        jumpPressedBuffered = false;
        jumpReleasedBuffered = false;

        // ---- 1) free motion over dt with the fitted model (relative coordinates)
        float svx = vx, svy = vy; bool sGrounded = grounded, sJump = jumpActive;
        float x = 0f, y = 0f;
        Advance(ref x, ref y, inputX, jumpHeld, dt, float.NegativeInfinity);

        // ---- 2) walls: resolve X first, at the current height
        float dx = x;
        bool hitWall = false;
        if (dx != 0f)
        {
            float gap = Gap(Vector2.zero, new Vector2(Mathf.Sign(dx), 0f), Mathf.Abs(dx) + skinWidth);
            if (gap >= 0f && gap - skinWidth < Mathf.Abs(dx)) { dx = Mathf.Sign(dx) * Mathf.Max(0f, gap - skinWidth); hitWall = true; }
        }

        // ---- 3) floor / ceiling probed from the NEW x position
        float dy = y;
        if (y < 0f && !grounded)
        {
            float gap = Gap(new Vector2(dx, 0f), Vector2.down, -y + skinWidth);
            if (gap >= 0f)
            {
                // redo the step with the floor known, so the landing happens at the exact time
                vx = svx; vy = svy; grounded = sGrounded; jumpActive = sJump;
                float x2 = 0f, y2 = 0f;
                Advance(ref x2, ref y2, inputX, jumpHeld, dt, -(gap - skinWidth));
                if (!hitWall) dx = x2;
                dy = y2;
                if (!grounded) { dy = -(gap - skinWidth); Land(); }  // numerical safety
            }
        }
        else if (y > 0f)
        {
            float gap = Gap(new Vector2(dx, 0f), Vector2.up, y + skinWidth);
            if (gap >= 0f && gap - skinWidth < y) { dy = Mathf.Max(0f, gap - skinWidth); vy = 0f; jumpActive = false; }  // head bump
        }
        if (hitWall) vx = 0f;
        // walked past an edge during this step -> start falling now (not one step later)
        if (grounded && dy == 0f && Gap(new Vector2(dx, 0f), Vector2.down, skinWidth * 2f + 0.001f) < 0f)
        {
            grounded = false;
            jumpActive = false;
            vy = 0f;
        }
        body.MovePosition(body.position + new Vector2(dx, dy));
    }

    /// <summary>Free distance from the collider (moved by offset) to the first solid surface in a
    /// direction, or -1 if there is none within maxDistance. Surfaces steeper than 60° relative to
    /// the cast direction are ignored (walls when probing floors and vice versa).</summary>
    float Gap(Vector2 offset, Vector2 direction, float maxDistance)
    {
        Vector2 scale = transform.lossyScale;
        Vector2 size = new Vector2(Mathf.Abs(box.size.x * scale.x), Mathf.Abs(box.size.y * scale.y));
        Vector2 center = body.position + Vector2.Scale(box.offset, scale) + offset;
        // cast a box shrunk by the skin so touching neighbours do not count as start overlaps
        Vector2 inner = new Vector2(Mathf.Max(0.001f, size.x - 2f * skinWidth), Mathf.Max(0.001f, size.y - 2f * skinWidth));
        int n = Physics2D.BoxCast(center, inner, 0f, direction, filter, hits, maxDistance + skinWidth);
        float best = -1f;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        {
            if (hits[i].collider == null || hits[i].collider == box) continue;
            if (hits[i].distance <= 0f) continue;                               // started inside: ignore
            if (Vector2.Dot(hits[i].normal, -direction) < 0.5f) continue;
            float g = hits[i].distance - skinWidth;
            if (best < 0f || g < best) best = Mathf.Max(0f, g);
        }
        return best;
    }
    /// <summary>Move instantly (spawn, respawn) and reset the motion state.</summary>
    public void Teleport(Vector2 position)
    {
        body.position = position;
        transform.position = position;
        vx = vy = 0f;
        grounded = false;
        jumpActive = false;
    }

    void Land()
    {
        grounded = true;
        vy = 0f;
        jumpActive = false;
    }

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Exact piecewise-constant-acceleration integrator (port of rcf/model.py: advance)
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    float MaxFall => maxFallSpeed > 0f ? maxFallSpeed : float.PositiveInfinity;

    void Horizontal(int u, out float target, out float rate)
    {
        float mult = grounded ? 1f : airControl;
        if (u == 0) { target = 0f; rate = groundDecel * mult; return; }
        if (vx * u < 0f) { target = 0f; rate = turnAccel * mult; return; }  // brake, then accelerate
        target = u * maxSpeed;
        rate = (Mathf.Abs(vx) > maxSpeed ? groundDecel : groundAccel) * mult;
    }

    float Gravity(bool held)
    {
        float g;
        if (vy > 0f) { g = riseGravity; if (!held) g *= releaseGravityMult; }
        else g = fallGravity;
        if (held && apexGravityMult != 1f && apexThreshold > 0f && Mathf.Abs(vy) <= apexThreshold) g *= apexGravityMult;
        return g;
    }

    void Advance(ref float x, ref float y, int u, bool held, float h, float floor)
    {
        float remaining = h;
        float maxFall = MaxFall;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < 64 && remaining > 1e-7f; iter++)
        {
            float target, rate;
            Horizontal(u, out target, out rate);
            float dv = target - vx;
            float ax = 0f, tx = float.PositiveInfinity;
            if (dv != 0f && rate > 0f) { ax = dv > 0f ? rate : -rate; tx = Mathf.Abs(dv) / rate; }

            float ay = 0f, ty = float.PositiveInfinity, tl = float.PositiveInfinity;
            if (!grounded)
            {
                if (vy <= -maxFall) { vy = -maxFall; ay = 0f; }
                else
                {
                    float g = Gravity(held);
                    ay = -g;
                    float next = -maxFall;
                    if (0f < vy && 0f > next) next = 0f;
                    if (apexThreshold > 0f)
                    {
                        if (apexThreshold < vy && apexThreshold > next) next = apexThreshold;
                        if (-apexThreshold < vy && -apexThreshold > next) next = -apexThreshold;
                    }
                    if (g > 0f && !float.IsInfinity(next)) ty = (vy - next) / g;
                }
                float c = y - floor;
                if (c >= 0f && !float.IsInfinity(floor))
                {
                    float a = 0.5f * ay, b = vy;
                    if (a == 0f) { if (b < 0f) tl = c / -b; }
                    else
                    {
                        float disc = b * b - 4f * a * c;
                        if (disc >= 0f) { tl = (-b - Mathf.Sqrt(disc)) / (2f * a); if (tl < 0f) tl = float.PositiveInfinity; }
                    }
                }
            }
            float seg = Mathf.Min(Mathf.Min(remaining, tx), Mathf.Min(ty, tl));
            x += vx * seg + 0.5f * ax * seg * seg;
            vx += ax * seg;
            if (seg == tx) vx = target;
            if (!grounded)
            {
                y += vy * seg + 0.5f * ay * seg * seg;
                vy += ay * seg;
                if (seg == tl) { y = floor; Land(); }
                else if (seg == ty) vy = SnapThreshold(vy, maxFall);
            }
            if (vy <= 0f) jumpActive = false;
            remaining -= seg;
        }
    }

    float SnapThreshold(float v, float maxFall)
    {
        // nudge just below the crossed threshold so the next segment uses the new gravity
        if (Mathf.Abs(v) < 1e-4f) return -1e-5f;
        if (apexThreshold > 0f && Mathf.Abs(v - apexThreshold) < 1e-4f) return apexThreshold - 1e-5f;
        if (apexThreshold > 0f && Mathf.Abs(v + apexThreshold) < 1e-4f) return -apexThreshold - 1e-5f;
        if (!float.IsInfinity(maxFall) && Mathf.Abs(v + maxFall) < 1e-4f) return -maxFall - 1e-5f;
        return v;
    }
}
